tasks.short: Evaluate microsystem materials, fabrication and packaging options.

steps.what: Reconcile actual candidate-material specifications and fabrication/packaging test data
Inspect and test actual material, joining, surface-treatment and packaging performance
Judge processing suitability, performance, cost, sustainability and availability trade-offs
Write and check actual option evaluation, evidence and limitations
Save the final microsystem option evaluation

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} material/test data imports and comparison fields. Engineer performs actual evaluations and judges processing and packaging trade-offs; imported attributes do not establish suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated candidate specification and measurement transfer.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import mappings and linked candidate fields.
tasks.still_hard: Material/fabrication interactions and uncertain packaging performance.
tasks.human_edge: Choose an option that actually meets device and process requirements.
tasks.altitude: Less data transfer; material and fabrication decisions unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native material and test imports reduce repeated data entry without selecting microsystem materials or packaging.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual option evaluation and record. Suppliers/test owners produce candidate ID, method, measured property, unit, conditions, date and source; sourcing owner actual price/availability and sustainability evidence where available. Engineer reconciles missing attributes manually in s1, tests in s2 and decides in s3. Unsupported sustainability data stays unknown.

Native first; existing imports yield zero. Provisional transfer15 is manual reconciliation/entry only; tests40, judgement30, actual writing14 and save1 unchanged. Shares unmeasured, no invented costs or improved performance baseline.
unknowns: Actual supplier/test data coverage and native mapping support
research_questions: Can mappings retain test conditions and candidate revisions?

tasks.short: Refine MEMS designs for dimensions, tolerances and processing.

steps.what: Review actual device targets, process capabilities and tolerance constraints
Choose and draw parameter refinements in MEMS CAD
Populate selected simulation cases and process-tolerance comparisons in microsystem analysis software
Judge actual tolerance sensitivity, device behaviour and process feasibility
Check actual sample or metrology evidence against the refined design
Write and check final refinement rationale and actual remaining limitations
Save the final MEMS refinement record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} MEMS parameterised geometry and repeat simulation-case fields. Engineer chooses actual refinements and checks process feasibility and metrology; no automated tolerance or manufacturing decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated geometry updates and scenario population.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parametric CAD and reusable analysis-case fields.
tasks.still_hard: Coupled dimensions, physical tolerances and real process variation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise which geometric changes are physically and manufacturably sound.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated model population; refinement decisions unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native parametric CAD and reusable simulation cases reduce repeated population without selecting a valid microsystem refinement.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual refinement and its verification record, not manufacturing release. Design owner supplies actual geometry/version and targets; fabrication owner actual process capability; metrology producer actual measured values, units and conditions. Engineer chooses refinement parameters in s2 and case assumptions in s3 before calculations; missing attributes manually resolved. No free process model or inferred verification.

Native first; s2 retains selection/drawing judgement within60 percent, only repetitive geometry changes reduce. s3 reduces manual case entry only, never solver runtime. Existing parametric setup earns zero saving. Provisional constraints15, evaluation20, verification10, record4 and save1 unchanged; shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Actual native parametric support and refinement repetition
research_questions: Can reusable cases preserve actual process and geometry revisions?

tasks.short: Develop MEMS invention and patent disclosure documents.

steps.what: Verify actual invention evidence, contributors, dates and prior technical material
Select accurate technical description, distinguishing features and supported embodiments
Write technical invention disclosure sections and attach actual device evidence

loop.purpose: Express the actual selected invention description
loop.input: verified invention evidence and engineer-selected technical description
loop.output: draft technical disclosure with evidence references and unknowns
loop.check: Engineer checks mechanism, embodiments, contributor facts, dates, unsupported novelty statements and disclosure of confidential material
loop.stop: Uncertain ownership, unsupported mechanism or two failed revisions requires manual composition
loop.why_not_simpler: Native disclosure form first; variable technical mechanism explanation needs bounded prose

steps.what: Check complete final disclosure and authorised internal intellectual-property destination
outputs: checked final invention disclosure and destination

steps.what: Save the final invention disclosure in the restricted document store
inputs: checked final invention disclosure and destination

steps.what: File the final disclosure with the authorised internal intellectual-property team
inputs: checked final invention disclosure and destination

tasks.design: Test native {OTHER} intellectual-property disclosure fields and restricted {DOCS} templates before bounded technical drafting. Engineer checks the complete final disclosure before separate save and internal filing; patent professionals retain legal claim drafting and any official application filing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical disclosure composition from actual device evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate invention boundaries, ownership and confidential disclosure.
tasks.human_edge: Describe what was actually invented and distinguish evidence from speculation.
tasks.altitude: Less technical disclosure writing; no legal patent authority gained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded technical drafting can restate supplied invention evidence; it does not establish novelty, inventorship or legal patent claims.

assumptions: This task's develop-or-file alternatives are represented by engineer development and internal invention disclosure filing, not official patent application submission. Engineer verifies actual device revision, experimental evidence, contributor records and dates in s1 and selects technical description in s2. Actual evidence owners supply source IDs and permitted access; missing ownership or evidence requires manual resolution, no invented patentability search.

Choose actual prototype-development sequence and resolve process questions with fabrication staff
Perform or inspect actual microfabrication and judge specification compliance during development
Enter and check actual process results, lot identifiers and development findings
Save the actual microfabrication development record
